case.narrative: I have now replaced the headlight bulbs in my 2016 KIA Sorento 6 times and it's getting worse as it gets older.   I believe it is a safety issue since the last time I was out of town, traveling in the middle of the night when it went out.  I had to wait until morning to find an auto parts store to buy and replace the bulb.  No inspections have been done by anyone. Yes, the warning lamp comes on and stays until reset.

decision.rationale: Safety flag stands; the case keeps priority for a live engineer.
